diagnosis: The repeated STT/Tele post-claim network boundaries were not product failures. The capability-fit law distinguished HTTP retrieval from representative JavaScript execution, but had no equally explicit rule for unrestricted_public_http_origin_fetch. Workers with only mediated search/web readers or code runtimes whose network was disabled therefore treated that specialized capability as unknown, won authority, and only then discovered DNS/origin reachability was impossible.
intervention: Added a capability-specific preclaim law to wc and FAST_ALLOCATION_PROTOCOL_V1: mediated/search/index/repository web access and code runtimes explicitly without network do not satisfy unrestricted_public_http_origin_fetch; absence of any arbitrary public-origin HTTP/DNS primitive makes that capability definitively absent before authority, while a genuine arbitrary HTTP client remains eligible and ambiguous tool surfaces remain unknown. Extended fast_allocator_capability_fit_v1 with mediated-web skip, genuine-client eligibility and ambiguity regressions. Added durable Efficiency Ratchet item EFF052 and checker enforcement.
remaining_boundary: EFF052 remains STATIC_GUARDED_PENDING_RUNTIME until a subsequent real /wc compact-frontier allocation observes an unrestricted_public_http_origin_fetch candidate and skips it preclaim solely from a runtime contract that definitively lacks arbitrary public-origin HTTP/DNS.
strategy_note: The owned GUIDE_CRITIC role fixed the mechanism-level task after authority; the FRONTIER_FIRST variant did not select or govern this slot.
authority_boundary: No Current, Human Accepted, Served, Catalog, credential, STT function state, or production /w authority changed.
